operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: RVQ sequentially selects entries from multiple codebooks and updates a residual after each codebook. The catalog has projection, lookup, addition, sampling, and reshaping, but none represents the documented ordered residual-codebook quantization algorithm without inventing its internal algebra.
